motd:
Season 0: Tingen

Choose Standard for Beyonder Shaders (shadows, red moonlight, gaslight and fog) or Lite for older computers. Press V to open your Spirit Vision.

news.title: Clowns, Magicians and crimson nights
news.body: Sequence 8 and 7 powers: Card Throw, Air Bullet, Flame Jump, Paper Substitute and Acrobatics (G to select, R to use). Full-moon nights turn crimson, soot drifts through the streets, church bells toll, chimneys smoke and the sun is round. Pendulum markers now stand on the surface.

news.title: The Seer pathway
news.body: Seer, Clown and Magician potions, Spirituality, digestion through acting, and loss of control. Divine with the Spirit Pendulum: rename it to ask a question and follow the spirit marker it leaves.

news.title: Beyonder Shaders and Spirit Vision halos
news.body: The Standard edition now ships our own shader pack: soft shadows, red moonlight, flickering gaslight, coal-smoke fog and lamp glow. Spirit Vision shows animated halos around players and creatures that grow brighter and change colour with their strength, and spirit markers for waypoints.

news.title: Tingen at Night
news.body: The first Beyonder mod build is in the pack: a muted Victorian color grade, thick night fog under a red moon, gas lamps and Tingen street blocks, and the Seer's Spirit Vision (press V).

news.title: Update test: launcher 0.1.3
news.body: Settings › Updates should offer a one-click update to 0.1.3.

editions.name: Standard
editions.description: Beyonder Shaders: soft shadows, red moonlight, flickering gaslight, coal-smoke fog and lamp glow. Needs a dedicated graphics card.

editions.name: Lite
editions.description: No shader pack. The Tingen color grade, fog and Spirit Vision still apply. Runs on most computers.
